author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the workshop of KNB EFX, Adam encounters one of the largest animatronic creatures the studio has created: a life-size elephant created for an action sequence in the show 1923. Shop Supervisor Carey Jones explains what it took to create this hyper realistic creature, which was based off of a real elephant filmed on location!

Learn more about KNB EFX's work at https://www.knbefx.com/
Why Movie Werewolves Look Like This: https://youtu.be/LM0HCaSTlAw
